content: The dissertation puts Ibn Turka's birth in 770/1369 'almost certainly' in Isfahan. The date is not stated in any source; it is computed from his statement in Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (completed 8 Rajab 829/16 May 1426) that he was 59 lunar years old. The family is said to descend from an ancestor who emigrated from Khujand.
